body:
> Original file: Downloads\GBP Review for Client- Blank.docx (Word document) ## What this document is for A client-facing audit template for one business location. It reviews the location's **Google Business Profile (GBP)** and its **website landing page**, lists what is missing, and gives a recommendation for each item. The client reads it, then approves it or asks for changes. Once approved, TAG makes the updates using the CMS and GBP access the client has given. ## How to use it 1. Make a copy of the blank template for the client and location. 2. Fill in the top table: GBP URL, landing page, location, recommended landing page, H1, and title tag. 3. Check each item in the two audit tables and fill in the **Result** column. 4. Replace every INSERT placeholder (NAP, schema, service areas, links, review link, photo folder, questionnaire link). 5. Send it to the client for approval, then make the approved changes. > Before sending: the template still holds sample values from an earlier client, such as a Google Maps embed for Right Way Driving School, "Private Hospital" as the primary category, and some Yes/No results. Clear or replace them for each new client. --- ## Document preview ### Location details | GBP URL | Landing Page | Location | | --- | --- | --- | | | | | | Recommended Landing Page | Recommended H1 | Recommended Title Tag | | --- | --- | --- | | | | | Below are recommendations for your Google Business Profile and the recommended landing page. Please respond to this document to let us know if this is approved, or if you'd like to request changes to this document. (For some items, we may need to coordinate to connect your GBP to our HighLevel platform. If you already have your GBP connected to a CMS platform capable of scheduling GBP posts, please grant us access to that and we won't need to connect to HighLevel.) Once approved, we will make these changes for you, using the credentials we've been given to manage or edit your CMS and GBP. ### Website landing page | Item | Result | Suggestion | | --- | --- | --- | | Name, Address, Phone # exact match? | | Ensure the Name, Address, and Phone Number (NAP) are on the landing page exactly as they appear on the GBP.
Add address to website. | | NAP appears in footer? | No | Add the NAP and location page to your footer. For this location, that is: INSERT | | Location page has local schema? | No schema present | Add Address and LocalBusiness schema to this page that matches the location's NAP from the GBP.
Here is the new LocalBusiness schema: (paste schema) | | Location page has content about the location? | No expanded geographical references | Add unique content about the location: staff, neighborhood and landmark references, the building, hours, services at this location, parking, inside building or plaza information, and directions from the city center.
This will be provided in the landing page content deliverable. | | Location page has GBP embed map? | | Add a GBP embed map showing your location on the page. For this location, that is: (Google Maps embed code) | | Google reviews score or testimonials embedded? | No | Add an embed of your Google reviews score to feature testimonials on this page, separate from the map. | | All phone links clickable (tap to call)? | No | Make all phone numbers clickable with a tel: link. | ### Google Business Profile | Item | Result | Suggestion | | --- | --- | --- | | Multiple categories? | No | Add more categories so the GBP appears in more relevant searches.
Recommended primary category: INSERT | | All items in GBP About section filled out? | | Fill out every GBP section as completely as possible. Sections change over time, so check periodically.
To make changes, we need: INSERT QUESTIONNAIRE LINK | | Special hours kept updated? | N | Keep hours up to date every month as Google adds options for upcoming holidays. | | 20 service areas completed? | Yes | Fill out all 20 service areas. They can overlap (city, county, zip, and so on). There is little evidence service areas affect ranking, but fill them in for completeness.
Recommended service areas: INSERT | | Products and Offers completed? | Yes | Post popular services in Products, and list active promotions and discounts in Offers.
Recommended products: INSERT | | Posts regularly updated? | Yes | Post regularly with locally relevant and service-related information. Posts should be unique to each location. | | Booking button active? | No | Integrate the website with GoHighLevel to add a booking button in Search and Maps. If approved, we will do this. | | Appointment or booking link active? | No | Add an appointment or booking link for this location: INSERT | | Services link active? | | Add a Services link to the page that lists all services at this location: INSERT | | Regular response to reviews? | | Respond publicly to every review, politely and on time. We will do this with GBP access, or you can respond yourself.
Total reviews: INSERT
Google rating: INSERT
Review link or QR card: INSERT | | 20+ unique, location-specific photos with geotagging? | | Add more photos of the inside and outside of the building, the staff, and the work at this location. Phone-quality photos are fine.
Photo drive folder: INSERT | | Services and service descriptions added? | | Add as many services and descriptions under each GBP category as possible. Do not duplicate services between categories.
Recommended services: INSERT | | Duplicate services or categories in services? | | Avoid duplicating services or categories in the services subsections.
Remove these services: Service (Category) |
name: GBP Review for Client (Blank Template)
